activation_selection: For UP and DOWN independently: mean of four QH prices per hour; select two highest hourly means each local day, non-contiguous allowed; average daily pairs equally within month
missing: Exclude any hour with missing/nonfinite QH price; do not interpolate or fill zeros; each day must contain at least two complete hours
zero_negative_prices: Retained as numeric published values; highest means descending numeric value, not absolute magnitude
price_unit: Activation and DA EUR/MWh; capacity EUR/(MW h); existing DAMAS proxy semantics retained
